detail.ambient_space: the constraint manifold X^r_vac(AF) of one-ended asymptotically flat vacuum data, with the SUBSPACE topology induced from the weighted Sobolev product H^s_delta x H^{s-1}_{delta+1} (not the unconstrained product, under which X_vac would be meager and no G would exist). X_vac is a closed subset of a Banach space, hence Baire, so G is non-empty.
detail.topology_or_measure: subspace topology on the constraint manifold; Frechet topology for the smooth-with-decay class. The diffeomorphism quotient is not used to define comeagerness (open technical gap).
